# GitHub Copilot — OneCompany Instructions

Follow `AGENTS.md`, `agents/UNIVERSAL-CONTRACT.md`, and `agents/copilot.md`.

Before editing, identify the Work Unit, canonical branch/PR, exact current head, active lease, acceptance criteria, budget constraints, and material authors. Never create a duplicate implementation stream for an already-leased WU. For deterministic failures, run the repository-pinned tool when possible instead of guessing its output. A material author cannot be the sole independent final gate for that head.
